q: When I next took an interest in things I found myself lying in the road. The sound of the gang was diminishing into the distance, and the prophet of doom, restored to eloquence, was sending threatful bolts of damnation, hell-fire, and a brimstone gehenna hurtling after them.
1951, John Wyndham, The Day of the Triffids, Harmondsworth: Penguin Books, published 1954, page 59:
